name: selvedge-mcp
stderr:
selvedge-mcp: no way to run the Selvedge MCP server was found on PATH.

Tried, in order: uvx, pipx, selvedge-server.
Selvedge is a Python package (Python >= 3.10): https://pypi.org/project/selvedge/

Fix with ONE of:
  1. Install uv   (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)  — this shim will run: uvx --from selvedge==0.3.16 selvedge-server
  2. Install pipx (https://pipx.pypa.io/)       — this shim will run: pipx run --spec selvedge==0.3.16 selvedge-server
  3. pip install "selvedge==0.3.16"                       — puts selvedge-server on PATH
     (equivalent module form: python3 -m selvedge.server)
